misc: Famous for being an ambassador for the AimPoint method for putting.
biography: Timo stands as a pillar of tactical putting mastery within the storied chronicles of the Hector Trophée, bringing his refined golfing talents from the immaculate fairways of Keimola Golf to the esteemed pair competition across nine distinct editions. Away from the pristine links, this dedicated competitor is widely celebrated among his peers as a passionate and devoted ambassador for the AimPoint method for putting, frequently enlightening fellow golfers with his meticulous approach to green reading and spatial geometry.

Beyond his advocacy for cutting-edge putting techniques, Timo has etched his name permanently into the tournament's record books through truly sensational competitive achievements. He has tasted the ultimate glory of lifting the coveted Hector Trophée on three separate occasions, cementing his status among the most decorated champions in the history of the event. While the individual accolades represented by the Victor Trophy have thus far remained outside his personal collection across his nine tournament appearances, his ongoing involvement in the vibrant community surrounding the tournament ensures that his compelling competitive journey remains fully active, leaving admirers in eager anticipation of his next masterclass on the course.
